summary: Web and mobile custom-object record pages now load and show a Related records section, with new relatedAdd/relatedRemove form actions that link/unlink records via the API's /objects/related/ using target obj:<key>; notifications pages (web + mobile) now render real_estate.match ('X fits an open requirement') and education.seat_open ('A seat opened in X') alerts with icons; version bumps to 1.40.0.

statements.why: Frontend proxies with the user's own session; no new auth, payment or db change.

statements.text: • The agent also changed frontend/src/lib/server/v2/custom-objects.ts, notifications.ts and related-records.ts, in ways plain can't describe yet.
statements.why: Real changes (related records actions, alert types).

statements.text: ◐ Type checking is turned off in 1 spot in frontend/src/lib/server/v2/related-records.test.ts (`any`).

misses.what: Custom record pages (web and mobile) now show a Related records section where users can add or remove links between custom records. The card only lists mobile file names and never mentions the web (frontend/) changes at all.
Real-estate match and education 'seat opened' alerts now appear in the notifications list (web and mobile) with readable text and icons instead of a generic/blank entry.
